raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 has 400 rows and an ingest window running to 22:00, which looks like a partial re-delivery. The raw table has 4825 rows but only 4802 distinct txn_ids, so some transactions were loaded twice and the duplicates flow into silver. The fix keeps one row per txn_id, the most recently ingested, and applies the POSTED filter afterwards. That way a later REVERSED copy can't be bypassed by an older POSTED copy.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.68,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
